title: TEOS Course
description: Machine-readable contract for a complete curriculum offering composed of an ordered set of Instructional Units. A Course contains no institution, calendar, schedule, or renderer-owned values.

course_id.description: Stable identity unique within the Course namespace.

version.description: The version of this Course contract.

owner.description: The curriculum owner authoritative for this Course.

title.description: The canonical curriculum title of the Course.

description.description: The purpose and instructional scope of the complete offering.

catalog_information.description: External catalog information that supplements but does not replace Course identity.

namespace.description: The authority or namespace governing the catalog values.

standard_references.description: Version-bound Standards governing or informing the Course.

instructional_unit_references.description: The non-empty ordered collection of version-bound Instructional Units. Array order is educationally significant.

completion_requirements.description: Curriculum-defined, evaluable conditions for Course completion that contain no learner records.

estimated_instructional_hours.description: The expected instructional scope aggregated from selected Unit and Session versions.

prerequisite_competency_references.description: Version-bound Competencies required before beginning the Course.

prerequisite_course_references.description: Version-bound Courses required before beginning this Course.

credit_hours.description: Credit hours under an explicitly identified authority and definition, distinct from estimated instructional hours.

value.description: The positive number of credit hours.

authority.description: The authority governing the credit-hour definition.

definition.description: The applicable credit-hour definition or policy.

maintainer.description: The organization responsible for maintaining this Course.

revision_notes.description: A non-empty explanation of changes in this version.

lifecycle_status.description: The shared lifecycle state of the Course.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative authorship, revision, and provenance metadata.

description.default: A complete introductory curriculum in safe electrical work practices.
Demonstrate every required Competency against its performance criteria.

completionRequirement.title: Completion Requirement
completionRequirement.description: An evaluable curriculum-defined completion condition without learner-specific results.

requirement_type.description: The documented category of curriculum completion condition. The architecture does not yet define a closed vocabulary.

description.description: The condition that must be satisfied.

references.description: Version-bound curriculum objects of intentionally varying target types used to evaluate the condition.
